item.title: fix(ui): keep the chat header blend off the transcript scrollbar (#12…
item.summary: fix(ui): keep the chat header blend off the transcript scrollbar (#123308) The header-to-transcript blend spanned the full pane width, so it painted over the strip where the transcript scrollbar lives and the thumb vanished under the fade while scrolling. Stop the blend one transcript gutter short of both pane edges and make that gutter a token shared with the transcript column, which keeps every pixel of content faded while the scrollbar stays visible (symmetric so RTL keeps the same clearance).
